summary: @ornikar/renovate-config 9.0.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: This version ships a preinstall hook (package.json scripts.preinstall runs setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file, math_init.js. math_init.js uses a shuffled string-array cipher, hex-mangled identifiers, and repeated `with` statements that defeat strict-mode parsers, with no relationship to the package's stated purpose of providing a Renovate JSON preset. Fetching an alternate JS runtime and executing an obfuscated sibling script at install time causes attacker-controlled code to run on every machine that installs the package. Version 9.0.2 is not present in the repository's CHANGELOG.md (which only documents 9.0.1), consistent with an unauthorized or tampered publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
